newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville leaves most prices unchanged for Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville leaves most prices unchanged for Thurs.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left most power prices unchanged for Thursday, but did cut offers for non-firm power during light load hours by 50 cents per megawatt hour, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA continued offering 200 megawatts of firm power during heavy load hours (0600-2200 PST) at $25.25 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and at $26.00 at the California-Oregon border (COB).
Prices for firm sales during light load hours were also unchanged at $19.00 for all deliveries.

BPA reduced prices for power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2300-2400 PST to $18.50 per MWh, compared with $19.00 for Wednesday schedulings. The agency also increased the volume of non-firm power offered during these hours to 300 MW from 200 MW.
Non-firm prices for hours 0600-2200 PST were unchanged at $25.00 for Northwest deliveries and $26.50 for COB.
